notes.title: 告死天使复仇之夜现已发售
notes.content:
已于2023年3月9日10点发售。
寒十做的告死天使系列第三部《告死天使复仇之夜》。
传统恐怖冒险游戏，有追逐战。
单线剧情，全成党利用存读档的话，不需要硬性多周目。
约2小时可以全成就通关。

notes.title: 《Death Angel NghtMare》 is expected to be released in March.
notes.content:
Today is the New Year's Eve. Gasai Kanju  here to wish you all good luck in the New Year!!
Explain the situation here. I am still very uncomfortable after the sunny day in December, and the efficiency of playing games has become much lower. So I am working all the time in the New Year (wiping tears)
Therefore, the current expected launch time is set at the beginning of March.
But the testers have their own business in reality every year. After the game is finished, it will take some time to ensure that most of the bugs have been eliminated before they can be put on the shelf. So there is not no possibility of ticket skipping at all. I apologize to you here first.
But I will do my best. Please cheer me up.
